question: Do candlestick patterns, classical chart patterns and indicators, used as model features (and as standalone events), give a net-positive BTC trade-suggestion pipeline?

windows.opened_year_status: Opened on 2026-09-24 by ma_ribbon_r1 (only H1-H4 rows). Used here once, for pre-registered final pipelines only. Labelled 'opened-year check', not a pristine test.
windows.prospective: append-only shadow log from the day a pipeline is frozen

worker_rules: Feature workers never set include_opened_year=True and never read bars at or after 2025-09-24.
Every compute/events function passes agentic_alpha_lab.patterns.common.assert_causal on real 1h, 4h and 1d development bars.
Chart-pattern pivots become available only after their confirmation bars have closed.
Event studies use common.event_study (development decisions, BH-FDR, half-stability).

labels.triple_barrier: entry at next open; long and short labelled separately; take-profit 2*ATR14 and stop 1*ATR14 from entry; timeout 12 bars (4h) or 10 bars (1d); stop-first when both touched in one bar; timeout label = sign of net move

model.estimator: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.03, max_iter=400, min_samples_leaf=100, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=0), one per side
feature_sets: base (returns, volatility, MA ribbon distances, daily context)
model.walk_forward: expanding, refit every 90 days, first prediction 2021-01-01, embargo 12 bars after the last realized label
model.policy: enter side with the larger probability if it exceeds threshold; one position at a time; bracket exits TP/SL/timeout as in labels
model.threshold_selection: maximize selection_validation net (normal costs) subject to >= 30 trades; ties -> higher threshold
gating_variants: daily ribbon gate (long only if close>SMA50>SMA200 on last closed day, short only if close<SMA50<SMA200)

costs: same as ma_ribbon_r1: fee 0.0002 per fill normal; stress 0.0006 fee + 0.0005 slippage; long funding 0.0001 per 8h, short 0; 1x compounded from 100

acceptance.development: walk-forward 2021-01-01..2025-09-13 net > 0 under stress, Sharpe above buy-and-hold over same window, >= 100 trades
acceptance.opened_year_check: net > 0 under normal and stress, intrabar DD <= 20%, >= 30 trades
acceptance.then: freeze and start prospective shadow; no live orders; 3% monthly reported as aspiration only
